name: Healthy Shepherd's Pie
desc: Beef and cabbage under a mashed parsnip top instead of potato

ingredients.raw: 2 large or 4 small carrots, finely diced
1 cup chicken stock, plus 1 1/2 cups for the parsnips
ingredients.item: chicken stock, plus 1 1/2 cups for the parsnips

ingredients.raw: 1 small head green cabbage, thinly sliced
8 to 10 parsnips, peeled and cut into 1 inch slices
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into 1 inch slices

steps: In a large saute pan over medium-high heat, heat the olive oil. Add the onions, garlic, carrots, celery and beef, and cook until browned, 8 to 10 minutes.
Drain the fat if there is a lot, then add the tomatoes, tomato paste and 1 cup chicken stock. Stir until the paste is blended in.
Add the cabbage and simmer until the sauce thickens and the cabbage is tender, about 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a 5 quart baking dish and set aside.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil, add the parsnips, and cook until tender, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain.
Mash the parsnips with the remaining 1 1/2 cups chicken stock until smooth, then season.
Spread the parsnip mash over the beef and bake until bubbling and lightly browned on top, about 20 minutes. Finish with parsley and chives.
